fonts.setup: Self-hosted WOFF2 in public/fonts, declared in src/styles/global.css. Inter variable (300-800) is the body default (body {font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif}); Hanken Grotesk variable (300-900) for titles/display via --font-family-title/--font-family-display; Satoshi 500/700 static (ITF FFL licence, not OFL) only for big money digits. index.html boot splash uses Inter, Arial fallback.
